proposition: marginal notes in the scroll may hide names and damaged annotations can conceal worst parts
quote: There are marginal notes," he said. "Different hands. Some names rubbed thin. You must be careful what you brush dust from.

proposition: rituals without witnesses and discretion risk turning a protective rite into a public incident with patrol scrutiny
quote: "Ritual without witnesses will make this worse if it is done in a hurry... We do not make smoke that a patrol might read as signal."

proposition: naming is meant to hold community memory; care and witnesses are required to avoid unloosing anger
quote: We name to hold, not to unloose anger.
